div.div:
REMITTANCE RELATIONSHIP PRINCIPLE
Oman Remit owns the remittance object.
The customer participates in the remittance relationship.
A remittance may produce financial consequences across the platform.
Cross-institutional financial effects are represented conceptually without
establishing a direct Remittance → Ananse Wallet relational relationship.
